title: Sızma Testi Uzmanı (Proje Bazlı)
description: GG Tech olarak, kendi geliştirdiğimiz bir web ürününün çalışan test ortamında manuel sızma testi yapacak bir uzman arıyoruz. Testin kaynak koda erişim olmadan, uygulama ve API üzerinden yürütülmesini istiyoruz. Beklentimiz, tespit edilen açıkların pratikte istismar edilebilirliğini ve etkisini yetkilendirilmiş test ortamında kontrollü biçimde doğrulamak. İlk çalışma tek ürün üzerinde ücretli ve proje bazlı olacak. Uzmandan bulguları ve düzeltme önerilerini raporlamasını, yazılım ekibimizle uygulamalı bir oturum yapmasını ve düzeltmelerden sonra bir tur yeniden test gerçekleştirmesini bekliyoruz. Başvururken benzer bir Web/API sızma testindeki rolünüzü, müsaitliğinizi ve varsa anonimleştirilmiş bir rapor örneğini paylaşabilirsiniz.

title: Software Development Team Lead
description: Would you like to take a leading role in developing innovative software solutions in a dynamic and fast-growing technology environment? We are looking for an experienced Software Development Team Lead to join our technology company and contribute to the design and development of scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions. What We’re Looking For Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. 8+ years of professional software development experience , including at least 2 years in a hands-on technical leadership role . Strong backend development expertise using Java, Spring Boot , and related technologies. Proven experience building and improving microservices-based applications and distributed systems. Solid understanding of software architecture, RESTful APIs, system integration, and backend design principles. Experience with asynchronous communication and messaging technologies such as Kafka , RabbitMQ, or equivalent solutions. Familiarity with SOAP, XML, and integration patterns across different systems. Experience applying AI-assisted development tools, specification-driven workflows, or emerging AI-enabled software engineering practices. Strong understanding of software quality, automated testing, code review processes, and maintainable coding practices. Ability to design and optimize applications with a focus on performance, scalability, reliability, and security. Experience in fintech, payment technologies, or financial services is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to guide technical discussions and support team development. What You’ll Do Provide technical guidance and day-to-day leadership to a team of software engineers, supporting their professional and technical development. Contribute to architectural planning and make informed technical decisions to support evolving business requirements. Take an active role in developing and enhancing Java-based backend applications, services, and integrations. Guide the implementation of scalable, secure, and resilient software solutions. Work collaboratively with Product, QA, DevOps, and other engineering stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle. Promote engineering standards through effective code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Explore and encourage the adoption of AI-enabled development tools and modern engineering approaches to improve delivery efficiency. Identify technical challenges, improve application performance, and contribute to the resolution of complex production issues. Support delivery planning, technical prioritization, and continuous improvement initiatives within an Agile working environment. Participate in technical evaluations and recruitment processes to help strengthen the engineering team. Build a collaborative team environment that balances technical excellence, quality, and business priorities.

title: Desktop Support
description: Job Title: Desktop Support (DSS) Job Location: Buyukhanli plaza , 34750, Istanbul , Türkiye (5 days onsite) Job Type: Contract Job Description: Key Accountabilities: VIP & Service‑Critical Support Deliver white‑glove IT support to VIP and executive users, ensuring rapid resolution, clear communication, and minimal business disruption. Proactively prioritize and manage VIP incidents and requests in accordance with SLA and business impact. Act as the primary on‑site escalation point for deskside and collaboration‑related issues affecting senior stakeholders. Maintain a consistently professional appearance and adhere to business‑appropriate dress standards when supporting VIP and executive users. Demonstrate high standards of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality in all interactions with senior stakeholders. Communicate respectfully and clearly, always maintaining a calm and courteous demeanour, especially in high‑pressure situations. Represent IT and the organisation positively through professional behaviour, punctuality, and attention to detail. Endpoint Engineering & Device Management Build, configure, deploy, and refresh end‑user devices using Microsoft SCCM and Microsoft Intune in line with corporate standards. Provide advanced support for Windows 11, including OS troubleshooting, patch validation, and post‑deployment issues. Perform hardware break/fix activities covering laptops, desktops, peripherals, docks, monitors, and printers. Maintain accurate asset records and ensure compliance with endpoint security and lifecycle policies. Identity & Access Operations Perform Active Directory L1/L2 administrative tasks, including user account management, group membership changes, and access troubleshooting. Support joiners, movers, and leavers (JML) activities in collaboration with relevant IT and business teams. Collaboration, Teams & Video Conferencing Provide operational support for Microsoft Teams, including meetings, calling, and collaboration features. Own on‑site support for Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) and Video Conferencing (VC) rooms
